note: Graded at 10 rows per repository, 50 in total. The pooled cross-language cell is the seeded 6 of each 10 flagged in_pooled_30, drawn with random.Random(2026).sample(range(10), 6) per repository, so C++ carries the same 30 rows every other language carries.
